about: Coole Park (NPWS, free) round 2. Delivered gor_001 Autograph Tree only; the 4-tree floor is not met. Coole's own pages (coolepark.ie, NPWS, UCC Tree Explorers) name only the Autograph Tree and Lady Gregory's catalpa; the rest of the estate trees are register rows with no names.

leads.name: Lady Gregory's Catalpa (replacement)
leads.source: Heritage Trees of Ireland, Tree Council of Ireland / Aubrey Fennell (NBDC dataset 27, CC BY 4.0), survey 2009
leads.reason: coolepark.ie: original blew down, replacement planted 1995 by Lady Gregory's granddaughters on the original site in the walled garden, so the standing tree is about 30 years old; register row (named, band 100-150 in 2009) may be the fallen original. Not ancient, not safely placed.

leads.source: Heritage Trees of Ireland, Tree Council of Ireland / Aubrey Fennell (NBDC dataset 27, CC BY 4.0), survey 2009
leads.reason: Exceptional specimen, multi-stem; register only, no name, nothing on the ground tells it apart, no life evidence; fungal-disease fellings in 2014.
